children.name: The Rabbit Active Explorer companion fits Ethan because he regularly participates actively in his workshops and tries to work independently. He shows a strong desire to explore tasks on his own, especially when he feels familiar with the steps. This active, hands-on approach highlights his natural curiosity and growing independence as a learner.

children.name: His connection to the Turtle Steady Builder is reflected in how carefully he works and his occasional need for gentle encouragement to start new or difficult tasks. Additionally, the Owl Thoughtful Learner pattern shines through in his highly deliberate approach, as he consistently works carefully and takes his time to ensure his steps are correct before moving forward.
